cohort: 65 women who chose group prenatal care and 130 women who chose standard individual care
finding: Group prenatal care resulted in similar gestational weight gain, pregnancy outcomes, and mode of birth compared to standard individual care, but with a significantly higher rate of exclusive breastfeeding at 6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: This study found that women choosing group prenatal care and women choosing standard individual care had similar rates of gestational weight gain, birth weight, gestational age at birth, and mode of birth.
